name: 隐写分析（隐藏数据检测）
description: 检测 hidden data embedded图像中的 through steganographic techniques, 表明 potential 篡改.
algorithm: Rich Model Steg分析 with Spatial Domain Features
mechanism: 提取 high-dimensional 特征 sets from spatial residuals using multiple filter kernels. 分析 统计 properties disrupted when data is hidden in LSBs or transform 系数.
parameters: Feature dimension: 34671 (full SRM), Filters: 30 linear + nonlinear, Quantization: T=1,2,3, Classifier: ensemble
source: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012) — Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Detecting hidden payloads图像中的 that may indicate data exfiltration or tamper concealment

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012) — Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• Extremely high-dimensional 特征
• Covers wide range of embedding methods
• State-of-the-art 检测 rates
• Generalizes 跨 steganographic algorithms
limitations:
• Very high computational cost
• Requires training data per embedding rate
• Large 特征 vectors need dimensionality reduction
• May produce 误报 on noisy images
